name: spell
description: Spell — hear it, spell it. Capacitor native wrapper around the Rust/WASM PWA.

scripts.entitlements:check: npm run entitlements:map && npm run entitlements:map:selftest && npm run entitlements:purity && npm run entitlements:audit-mode
scripts.build: node scripts/i18n-check.mjs && node scripts/viewport-check.mjs && python3 scripts/build-wordlists.py --check && bash scripts/build-web.sh && node scripts/seam-absence-check.mjs dist && python3 tools/bundle_scans.py && python3 tools/manifest_check.py && node scripts/wordpic-check.mjs && node scripts/chrome-separation-check.mjs && node scripts/vision-seam-check.mjs && cargo test --features web consts::registry_tests -q && cargo check -p tracer-core -q
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && cap sync ios
